facts.value: Restarts dmg.x18F4 from common x648, assigns that count to dmg.x1954 only when strictly greater, sets x2220_b4 and invokes Fighter_UnkRecursiveFunc_8006D044. After that callback-capable helper, selects x64C for exact GA_Air or x650 otherwise and submits angle-derived air or floor-tangent response components. ftCo_Damage_CalcVel can merge with or preserve existing world knockback, not always replace it. Air clears ground knockback; non-air stores the new ground scalar. Finally calls ftCommon_800804FC. Normal facing reversal requires an uninterrupted positive countdown; suppression, cancellation, zero duration, and callback mutation can prevent completion.

facts.value: Both response entries copy common x648 into integer dmg.x18F4, update floating dmg.x1954 only when the count compares strictly greater, set x2220_b4 and invoke the callback-capable hitlag helper. The ordinary entry forms angle/magnitude components; the shield-called entry uses x654*(-specialn_facing_dir). Floor-relative submissions construct the tangent vector (normal.y*scalar,-normal.x*scalar), not a projection onto the normal. The updater converts the pre-decrement countdown to temporary yaw and commits facing/TopN orientation on the decrement to zero.

facts.value: The updater is inactive solely when dmg.x18F4 equals zero. Otherwise it computes pi*(x648-counter)/x648 before decrementing and writes temporary TransN yaw through two APIs. The decrement to zero clears x2220_b4, negates facing, aligns TopN, clears temporary yaw and invokes the current non-null x21F8 without clearing it. For unchanged positive N, nominal samples are 0 through pi*(N-1)/N, subject to floating rounding; N=1 completes at temporary yaw zero. Initializing N=0 leaves the active bit set without completion. Negative counts, changed or zero denominators, and integer overflow are unguarded. Maintenance can suppress updates and state-reset code can cancel the timer. The updater itself has no post-callback Fighter access, but its maintenance caller continues accessing Fighter state; callback destruction safety is not proved.
facts.rationale: Replace half-turn-per-update wording with exact sampling, edge cases, cancellation, and whole-caller lifetime qualification.
